=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/review_run_reviewers.sh:258 | severity=medium | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3-flash-preview, deepseek_deepseek-v3_2, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5]
  PROBLEM: The status filter includes `OPEN`, which is not a valid ledger status value.
  WHY: The ledger status model uses `NEW`, `PERSISTING`, `FIXED`, `RESURGENT`, and `accepted-residual`, so `OPEN` is dead code; reviewers disagreed on impact, with some calling it minor/hardening-only.
- scripts/review_run_reviewers.sh:254-256 | severity=medium | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5]
  PROBLEM: The `NF < 4` guard is positioned after the awk block opens, allowing malformed rows with fewer than four fields to reach the path reference.
  WHY: A short or malformed ledger row could leave `$4` undefined and produce unpredictable behavior when the script processes it.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

  WHY: The parser was using the wrong column mapping for the ledger row format, which would break iteration scoping and cause reviewers to miss persistent issues.
- scripts/review_run_reviewers.sh:262 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The regex for stripping line-range suffixes from paths was incomplete.
  WHY: The existing pattern did not cover all line-range formats, so some path metadata could survive and interfere with downstream file handling.
- scripts/review_run_reviewers.sh:258 | severity=low | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The status filter included `OPEN`, which is not a valid ledger status.
  WHY: The ledger uses `NEW`, `PERSISTING`, `FIXED`, `RESURGENT`, and `accepted-residual`, so `OPEN` never matches and should not be checked.
- scripts/review_run_reviewers.sh:301 | severity=low | confidence=none
